tasks.title: Set up Turso database and Drizzle ORM foundation
tasks.description: Install dependencies (@libsql/client, drizzle-orm, drizzle-kit), create Turso database schema with furiganas table and composite index, configure Drizzle client
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test: Verify Drizzle client initializes without errors in test environment using ':memory:' URL. Integration test: Verify table creation by inserting a test row and reading it back with Drizzle query builder. Check that composite index exists via SQLite PRAGMA.

tasks.title: Create generic pagination and furigana Zod schemas
tasks.description: Create reusable pagination.schema.ts with CursorSchema and PaginationResultsSchema factory. Extend furigana.schema.ts with database row schemas using drizzle-orm/zod
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test: Validate PaginationResultsSchema with test data schemas. Test CursorSchema accepts valid cursor shape and rejects malformed data. Test FuriganaInsertSchema validates all fields correctly. Test FuriganaRowSchema validates database row shape. Test FuriganaPaginationResultsSchema validates paginated response envelope.

tasks.title: Implement cursor-based pagination query functions
tasks.description: Create app/lib/db/queries.ts with insertFurigana, getFuriganaById, and listFuriganas using cursor-based pagination with (createdAt, id) composite cursor
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test with in-memory SQLite: insertFurigana creates row correctly. getFuriganaById returns row for valid ID, null for missing/deleted. listFuriganas returns first page with no cursor. listFuriganas with cursor returns correct next page. Verify nextCursor is null on last page. Verify total count excludes soft-deleted entries. Test cursor stability when new entry is inserted.

tasks.title: Update furigana.service.ts to return annotation string
tasks.description: Modify generateFurigana() to return both annotationString and FuriganaToken[] instead of tokens only
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test: Verify return value includes both annotationString and tokens properties. Verify annotationString matches the raw GPT-4o-mini output. Verify tokens array is correctly parsed from annotationString. Existing tests for generateFurigana must be updated to destructure the new return shape.

tasks.title: Update home.tsx action to persist to Turso
tasks.description: Replace in-memory token storage with Turso INSERT via insertFurigana, update generateFurigana call to use new return shape
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: Submit form, verify Turso INSERT succeeds, verify redirect to /furigana/:id with persisted ID. Test Turso write failure after successful AI generation returns error with originalText preserved. Verify entry ID is valid UUID. Mock generateFurigana to avoid AI calls in tests.

tasks.title: Update furigana.$id.tsx loader to read from Turso
tasks.description: Replace consumeTokens with getFuriganaById and parseAnnotationString, throw 404 for missing/deleted entries
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: Load route with valid entry ID, verify tokens are parsed correctly. Load route with non-existent ID, verify 404 response. Load route with soft-deleted entry (deletedAt IS NOT NULL), verify 404 response. Unit test parseAnnotationString integration with database row.

tasks.title: Delete token-storage.service.ts and update tests
tasks.description: Remove app/services/token-storage.service.ts and app/services/token-storage.service.test.ts since in-memory storage is replaced by Turso
tasks.details:
Delete files:
- `app/services/token-storage.service.ts`
- `app/services/token-storage.service.test.ts`

Verify no remaining imports of these modules in the codebase via grep:
```bash
grep -r "token-storage.service" app/
```

Update any test files that mock or import token-storage to remove those references.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify `pnpm type-check` passes after deletion. Verify `pnpm test` passes with no broken imports. Grep for any remaining references to token-storage in app/ directory returns zero results.

tasks.title: Install TanStack Query and create API client layer
tasks.description: Install @tanstack/react-query, create app/lib/api/furiganas.ts with fetchFuriganaList and fetchFuriganaById using axios instance + Zod validation
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test with axios-mock-adapter: Mock GET /api/furiganas response, verify fetchFuriganaList parses and returns correct shape. Mock malformed response, verify Zod validation throws error. Mock GET /api/furiganas/:id, verify fetchFuriganaById parses correctly.

tasks.title: Create API resource routes for furigana data
tasks.description: Create app/routes/api/furiganas.ts (GET with cursor pagination) and app/routes/api/furiganas.$id.ts (GET single entry)
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: GET /api/furiganas returns paginated results matching FuriganaPaginationResultsSchema. GET /api/furiganas?limit=5 returns 5 entries. GET /api/furiganas?cursor=<valid> returns next page. GET /api/furiganas?cursor=invalid returns 400. GET /api/furiganas/:id returns entry. GET /api/furiganas/nonexistent returns 404.

tasks.title: Install shadcn/ui Sidebar component
tasks.description: Install shadcn/ui Sidebar component via CLI, which includes Sheet, Separator, Tooltip, Input, and Skeleton dependencies
tasks.details:
Run shadcn CLI to install Sidebar component:
```bash
pnpx shadcn@latest add sidebar --defaults
```

This installs the following components into `app/components/ui/`:
- `sidebar.tsx` (main Sidebar primitives)
- `sheet.tsx` (for mobile drawer mode)
- `separator.tsx`
- `tooltip.tsx`
- `input.tsx`
- `skeleton.tsx`

Verify the installation by checking that `app/components/ui/sidebar.tsx` exists and exports:
- `Sidebar`
- `SidebarProvider`
- `SidebarHeader`
- `SidebarContent`
- `SidebarFooter`
- `SidebarGroup`
- `SidebarGroupContent`
- `SidebarMenu`
- `SidebarMenuItem`
- `SidebarMenuButton`
- `SidebarMenuSkeleton`
- `SidebarInset`
- `SidebarTrigger`

No conflicts expected with existing shadcn/ui components (button, card, textarea).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify `app/components/ui/sidebar.tsx` exists. Verify `pnpm type-check` passes. Verify all Sidebar primitives are exported and importable. Check that Sheet, Separator, Tooltip, Input, and Skeleton components are also installed in `app/components/ui/`.

tasks.title: Create AppSidebar component with TanStack Query
tasks.description: Build app/components/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx using shadcn/ui Sidebar primitives and useInfiniteQuery for cursor-based pagination
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test: Render AppSidebar with mocked useInfiniteQuery, verify skeleton shows during loading. Verify empty state renders when entries is empty. Verify entry list renders with correct Link hrefs. Verify Load more button appears when hasNextPage is true. Integration test with MSW: Mock /api/furiganas endpoint, verify fetchNextPage triggers correct API call with cursor.

tasks.title: Create layout route with QueryClientProvider and SidebarProvider
tasks.description: Create app/routes/layout.tsx wrapping QueryClientProvider, SidebarProvider, AppSidebar, and SidebarInset with Outlet
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: Render layout route, verify QueryClientProvider wraps tree. Verify SidebarProvider wraps tree. Verify AppSidebar renders. Verify Outlet renders child route content. Verify activeEntryId is correctly derived from URL params. E2E test: Navigate between routes, verify sidebar persists across navigation.

tasks.title: Implement cache invalidation after new submission
tasks.description: Add TanStack Query cache invalidation for sidebar query after successful form submission redirect
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test: Submit form, verify TanStack Query cache is invalidated for ['furiganas', 'list']. Verify sidebar refetches and displays new entry at the top. E2E test: Submit text, verify new entry appears in sidebar immediately after redirect without manual refresh.

tasks.title: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
tasks.description: Create unit tests for pagination schemas, database queries, API functions, and integration tests for route actions/loaders
tasks.details:
Create test files:

**`app/schema/pagination.schema.test.ts`:**
- Test `PaginationResultsSchema` with test item schema validates correct shape
- Test rejects missing fields (nextCursor, hasMore, etc.)
- Test CursorSchema validates { createdAt, id }
- Test CursorSchema rejects malformed cursor

**`app/lib/db/queries.test.ts`:**
- Test insertFurigana creates row
- Test getFuriganaById returns row / null for missing / deleted
- Test listFuriganas first page (no cursor)
- Test listFuriganas subsequent page (with cursor)
- Test listFuriganas nextCursor null on last page
- Test listFuriganas total count
- Test cursor stability with new insert

**`app/lib/api/furiganas.test.ts`:**
- Mock axios responses with axios-mock-adapter
- Test fetchFuriganaList validates with FuriganaPaginationResultsSchema
- Test fetchFuriganaList throws on malformed response
- Test fetchFuriganaById validates with FuriganaRowSchema

**Update `app/routes/home.test.tsx`:**
- Update tests for new action behavior (Turso INSERT instead of in-memory)
- Mock insertFurigana
- Verify redirect to /furigana/:id
- Test error handling (Turso write failure)

**Update `app/routes/furigana.$id.test.tsx`:**
- Update tests for loader using getFuriganaById
- Mock getFuriganaById
- Test 404 for missing entry
- Test 404 for soft-deleted entry

**Update `app/services/furigana.service.test.ts`:**
- Update tests for new return shape { annotationString, tokens }
tasks.testStrategy: Run `pnpm test` and verify all tests pass. Run `pnpm test:coverage` and verify coverage thresholds are met for new modules (pagination schema, db queries, api functions). Verify no regressions in existing test suites.

tasks.title: Write E2E tests for sidebar and persistence
tasks.description: Create Playwright E2E tests for submission flow, sidebar navigation, page reload persistence, and cursor-based pagination
tasks.testStrategy: Run `pnpm test:e2e` and verify all tests pass. Tests should use a clean test database (in-memory SQLite or separate Turso test instance) to avoid conflicts with dev data. Verify sidebar navigation, persistence, pagination, and cache invalidation work correctly in a real browser environment.
